invite.title: Invite a relative
invite.intro: Mbia creates a link that you send yourself, for example on WhatsApp.

roleHelp.CONTRIBUTOR: Can add people, links and memories.
roleHelp.VIEWER: Can look at the family, without changing anything.

invite.notAdmin: Only the family's administrator can invite relatives.

cannot.linked: {{name}} is already linked to a member of the family: there is no one to invite.
cannot.deceased: {{name}} is recorded as deceased, so they cannot be invited.
cannot.inactive: {{name}} was archived or merged, so they cannot be invited.
cannot.pending: An invitation for {{name}} is already waiting. Renew it from their profile to get a new link.

share.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it yourself.
share.withPerson: {{inviter}} invites you to the {{family}} family on Mbia, your profile {{person}} is waiting for you: {{link}}
share.withoutPerson: {{inviter}} invites you to the {{family}} family on Mbia: {{link}}
share.once: This link works only once and expires in 14 days.
share.notShownAgain: It will not be shown again: if needed, renew the invitation to get a new link.

profile.renewed: New link created. The previous link no longer works.

refused.INVITATION_ALREADY_USED: This invitation has just been used: {{name}} has probably joined the family.
refused.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: This invitation changed in the meantime. Check it and try again.
